issues.desc: background.md uses the term "full-3x2" in the Trigger Event and Key Insight sections without defining what the 3 and 2 stand for (round count and host count). The surrounding context gives "dual-host" but the quorum number (3) and its meaning in the escalation flow are never stated. A fresh reader cannot infer the quorum semantics from background.md alone, yet the term is central to the empirical-evidence claim.

background.md uses the shorthand labels S4 and S5 throughout (Trigger Event, Conversation Texture) without stating the corresponding story IDs (B-fa7c and B-086b respectively). The inline descriptions of what was found are present, but a reader wishing to independently verify or cross-reference cannot do so from background.md alone.

The Trigger Event paragraph attributes the S4 corrupt-scope-contract crash to the completeness critic / multi-lens workflow, but per the B-fa7c findings file, the crash finding (F-002) was filed by the claude-quality dimensional lens, while the completeness critic (claude-critic) filed F-003 covering the coverage gap. The primary crash bug was found by a dimensional lens, not the critic. The phrasing is imprecise and could mislead a reader about which component of the workflow contributed which defect.

Conversation Texture references "the 5-lens Workflow" without listing what the 5 lenses are. A fresh reader cannot determine the lens breakdown (concept/quality/behavior/test-coverage/crash-safety or similar) from background.md alone. The number is asserted as a fact but the content is omitted.
